title: Trump’s War With Iran Drags Down Republicans in Midterm Elections
partialText: As their midterm picture darkens, and gas and diesel prices soar, some Republicans who backed the war for months are now changing their tune.

title: ‘She’s One of Us’: Mary Peltola’s Bumpy Rise to Political Power
partialText: Ms. Peltola, the Democratic Senate candidate in Alaska, has complicated politics: She is pro-gun, pro-oil and pro-gas — but also pro-environment and especially pro-fish.

title: Washington Taxed Its Millionaires. Now the Rich Want It Repealed.
partialText: Washington State voters will get a chance to accept or reject the 9.9 percent income tax on millionaires approved by the Legislature, which broke the state’s taboo against levying income taxes.

title: 5 Arrested on Suspicion of Terrorism Near RAF Fairford Air Base in UK
partialText: The British counterterrorism police say the men were arrested after three suspicious vehicles appeared to be traveling toward R.A.F. Fairford early on Sunday.

title: As A.I. Accelerates, Governments Are Increasingly Being Left Behind
partialText: The gap between technology and policymaking has gotten wider than ever with artificial intelligence, leaving a global policy vacuum as A.I. models rapidly advance.

title: The Daredevil Aviator on Page 1
partialText: In 1910, there was no greater journalistic mission than following a plane with a train.

title: Kyle MacLachlan: David Lynch’s Singular Weirdo Is Secretly a Normie
partialText: The actor still hasn’t come to grips with the loss of David Lynch. He talks about that, his hesitation about taking a role in “Sex and the City” and his new memoir.

title: The Mean Girls Presidency
partialText: Our government is being run by a clique of middle-aged guys.

title: Giant Pandas, Icons of China’s Soft Diplomacy, Arrive in Atlanta
partialText: A male named Ping Ping and a female named Fu Shuang landed on Sunday, days after China’s leader said he would dispatch “envoys of friendship” to the United States.
